Emma Possfelt-Møller is a consultant physician (*overlæge*) who plays a key role in the clinical governance of the Danish Acute Surgery Database. She serves as a member of the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Group), representing both the Danish Surgical Society (*Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab*) and Rigshospitalet in the Capital Region of Denmark (*Region Hovedstaden*) [^src1]. 

Her position places her within the organizational leadership responsible for overseeing quality indicators in acute surgery, such as the treatment of perforated ulcers [^src1]. The 2025 annual report for the database outlines the systemic challenges that her steering group navigates, which include regional disparities in identifying high-risk acute patients, data registration issues, and the complexities of interpreting clinical metrics at tertiary centers like Rigshospitalet [^src1]. Through her dual representation of a major national hospital and the national surgical society, Possfelt-Møller contributes directly to the strategic and clinical oversight of the database's quality improvement initiatives [^src1].
